method.zscore: composite = mean(-z_ndvi, z_lst, -z_esi, -z_sm) > 1.0, or two of z_ndvi < -1, z_lst > +1, z_sm < -1 (ds method A)
method.isolation_forest: IsolationForest(n_estimators=200, contamination=0.1, random_state=0) on the six z-scores (missing = 0), fitted on crop-year in-season weeks (ds method B)
method.z_scores: leave-one-year-out; NDVI, LST and ESI vs years with the same crop on this field (>= 5, else all crop years); ETo and 30-day rain vs all other years; soil moisture from the product percentile (probit)
method.status: both / one / none; 'water' = water seen that week (never stress); 'fallow' = no crop (scored, never shown as stress)
method.drivers: keys of the z-scores beyond 1 in the stress direction; `reasons` says the same in words

inputs.tmax: NOAA NCEI GHCN-D station mean (data/cache/<fid>/ncei.parquet); NASA POWER T2M_MAX where no station reports
inputs.eto: FAO-56 Penman-Monteith (backend/engine weather.pm_eto): station Tmax/Tmin, POWER ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN, WS2M, RH2M; elevation 106.13 m, latitude 36.324
inputs.imerg: NASA GPM IMERG V07 daily (Final, Late after 2025-09-30), backend/nasa imerg.parquet
inputs.smap_pct: NASA SMAP L4 SPL4SMGP.008 sm_rootzone_pctl (backend/nasa smap_l4.parquet); GRACE-DA GRACEDADM_CLSM025GL_7D rtzsm_inst percentile where SMAP is missing
inputs.ndvi_modis: MOD13Q1.061 NDVI at the field centroid (missing), good/marginal pixels
inputs.ndvi_hls: field-median NDVI, S2 L2A (backend/field) first, then HLS (backend/nasa, nasa_open), then Landsat C2 L2
inputs.water: S2/Landsat NDWI > 0.3 or SCL water > 50% on the field, or OPERA DSWx-HLS water >= 50% of the clear field
inputs.lst: ECOSTRESS ECO_L2T_LSTE.002 (backend/nasa) where cached, else MODIS MOD11A2.061 LST_Day_1km (Planetary Computer)
inputs.esi: ECOSTRESS ECO_L4T_ESI.002 where cached; else ECOSTRESS ECO_L3T_JET ETdaily / Penman-Monteith ETo (same ratio as ESI, AppEEARS bundle in data/cache/_appeears); else OpenET Ensemble monthly ET / Penman-Monteith ETo
inputs.usdm: US Drought Monitor county statistics, cumulative % area in D3-D4 (data/cache/<fid>/usdm*.parquet)
